title: The war with the Canaanites ends
summary: Jones dates the end of a seven-year war with the Canaanites. The length stays in the quotation.
description: Jones dates the end of a seven-year war with the Canaanites. The length stays in the quotation. The year is the Appendix F figure, stored as printed.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones): 1445 BC (no higher-tier year available).

chronologies.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 278 (PDF p. 313)
chronologies.note: Jones prints “7-year”. No end span was stored beyond the printed year of the ending. conquest-of-canaan was not edited.
